projects.title: Metal Galaxy
projects.shortDescription: A platform that aims to unite the metal music ecosystem in one place.
projects.longDescription: Metal Galaxy is a comprehensive platform designed to bring together every member of the metal community—from fans to bands to promoters. The platform features three major components: a community-driven encyclopedia, a live show agenda, and a social network connecting fans and bands.

projects.title: FixPilot
projects.shortDescription: A platform to automate conversations with service providers using ChatGPT.
projects.longDescription: FixPilot helps property managers spend less time handling emails and more time doing their job. The platform reads incoming emails and takes actions based on intent, while ensuring humans have the final say in case of ambiguity.
achievements: Shipped MVP successfully
Created scalable architecture to support long-term vision
Implemented automated testing for critical features
Set up CI/CD pipeline

projects.title: Flowchase App
projects.shortDescription: An application to help students improve their oral English skills.
projects.longDescription: The platform provides exercises created by linguists to test and challenge students, offering feedback based on recorded audio. Feedback includes corrections and practical tips to enhance speaking skills.
achievements: Stabilized the mobile application, reducing user complaints by nearly 100%
Reduced infrastructure costs by more than 50%
Implemented bug reporting tool to assist support team
Set up CI/CD pipeline

projects.title: Flowchase Teacher Portal
projects.shortDescription: A platform for teachers to create and manage classes while tracking student progress.
projects.longDescription: The teacher portal enables teachers to create and manage classes, monitor student progress, and customize lessons tailored to each class's needs.
achievements: Created automated class creation feature, eliminating support team intervention
Redesigned UI for improved user experience and usability

projects.title: Flowchase Practice Tool
projects.shortDescription: A platform to help anyone improve their English skills.
projects.longDescription: The Flowchase Practice Tool enables anyone to train their English skills with a strong focus on speaking. The tool leverages the Flowchase App's AI to provide feedback on user-submitted text rather than pre-created content. To maximize learning, the tool also generates audio samples (using ElevenLabs) demonstrating correct pronunciation.
achievements: Shipped MVP successfully
Implemented CI/CD pipeline

projects.title: Sayl Wallet

description: Founded Metal Galaxy, a platform designed to unite the global metal music community by connecting fans, bands, and promoters in one centralized ecosystem.

Led complete product vision, design, and full-stack development from concept to launch, building key features including a community-driven encyclopedia, comprehensive live show agenda, and social networking capabilities to foster connections within the metal community.

Led the end-to-end development of an AI-powered platform that automates property manager communications with service providers using ChatGPT, significantly reducing manual email handling time and improving operational efficiency.

Architected and built complete infrastructure from scratch, implementing comprehensive automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable cloud infrastructure on Scaleway to support the long-term product vision and ensure reliable performance at scale.

Led development of a comprehensive English learning platform consisting of a mobile app, teacher portal, and practice tool, leveraging AI to provide real-time feedback on speaking skills and pronunciation.

Achieved significant improvements by stabilizing the mobile application (reducing user complaints by nearly 100%), optimizing infrastructure costs (over 50% reduction), and automating class creation workflows to completely eliminate manual support intervention.

Developed and maintained the Sayl ecosystem, a comprehensive suite of e-commerce and restaurant management solutions including Sayl Retail (a Shopify alternative), Sayl Resto (online ordering platform), and innovative NFT/POAP wallet integration for customer loyalty programs.

Implemented critical features across web and mobile platforms including video call shopping, loyalty programs, and custom layouts, while achieving dramatic performance improvements (reducing load times from 10 seconds to 10 milliseconds in Store Manager) and modernizing the UI/UX across all products.

Contributed to the development of Lychee OS, an operating system for 3D printers with integrated Lychee Slicer functionality, working with Go, C, and web technologies to create a seamless printing experience.

Implemented key features including print timelapse recording, a recurring payment system with Mollie integration, and a web portal for seamless printer-to-slicer connectivity, while conducting R&D to optimize image rendering performance on embedded systems.
